content: Thank you for helping me with my visa for the second time (90 Days). The JMR team has been amazing, and I really appreciate how easy and smooth the process was. I’ll definitely recommend JMR to anyone needing visa help!

Miss Jill made everything so much easier! I’m absolutely over the moon and can’t wait to visit Switzerland! Even though it’s just for 13 days because of work here. I’m sure I’ll be able to visit again soon! Thank you for your assistance!
Thank you for guiding us with our application Jill. Thank you so much and sorry to have you been stressed during the process. Thank God! my visa is approved! Thank you so much for helping us!

Thank you Miss Jill for everything that you helped us with my application for visit visa to Poland to visit my husband. Thank you for your patience. It’s my first time applying for a Schengen visa and I got approved right away.

With the help of JRM Visa Services, I finally managed to get my visa for marriage to Belgium. It wasn’t easy, but by working together and waiting for some time, now I'm here with my fiancé in Belgium. Thank you so much for your service!

We are heartily grateful for Ms Jill’s help to get through my French visa for the marriage purpose. She always attend to our queries and never missed any single details making the visa process smooth from my application until my flight to France!

We’re family of six and we got our Schengen visa approved for Germany! Thank you so much, Ms. Jill for assisting us, you're the best Very accommodating and easy to talk to in terms of all the things that we need for this visa application.

I’m super grateful to Ms. Jill. We all got approved as a family of 4 for  our Schengen visa application! She is very hands on and always checking on me during processing of our requirements. Her tips and advices are so helpful. Thank you so much!

A big thanks to you Jill for your professionalism. Indeed, both times I applied for my Schengen Visa with you, our application was rewarded with success. You also always respond very fast whenever I have questions. Thanks again!
